title: NASA’s SpaceX Crew-9 Post-Splashdown News Conference – Tuesday, March 18, 2025
description: NASA and SpaceX discuss the return to Earth of the Crew-9 mission from the International Space Station.   Joel Montalbano, deputy associate administrator, NASA’ Space Operations Mission Directorate Steve Stich, manager, NASA’s Commercial Crew Program Bill Spetch, operations integration manager, NASA’s International Space Station Sarah Walker, director, Dragon Mission Management, SpaceX   Join NASA as we go forward to the Moon and on to Mars -- discover the latest on Earth, the Solar System and beyond with a weekly update in your inbox.  Subscribe at: https://www.nasa.gov/subscribe

via: the NASA Image and Video Library
